title: Warm Baba Ganoush
description: A delicious and creamy eggplant dip originating from the Middle East. Perfect for snacking or as a side dish.
instructions: Place the eggplant on a baking sheet and roast for 30-40 minutes, or until the skin is charred and collapsed.
Remove the eggplant from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Peel the eggplant and place it in a blender or food processor.
Add the baba ghanoush, lemon juice, garlic, salt, tahini, and paprika to the blender.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
With the blender running, slowly pour in the olive oil.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
